label: PF Backlog 572
title: CI/CD review & optimization: clear change-based gate/test/profile mapping (de-ambiguate commit/merge/push/CI)
body:
## Problem / why
The CI/CD gate/test surface has grown large and the mapping "what runs on commit vs merge vs push vs CI, and which
tests/gates matter for a given change/profile" is ambiguous - hard to reason about and optimize (time, overlap,
redundancy), and easy to be surprised by a pre-existing gate failing.

## Goal & value
A reviewed, optimized CI/CD that is explicit and change-aware:
- One authoritative mapping: change type -> which gates/tests run, at which boundary (pre-commit hook / pre-push /
  precheck tier / CI structure / release).
- Profiles (FEATURE_PR / INTEGRATION / DOGFOOD / RELEASE) make the depth explicit.
- Identify overlap/redundancy (gates running twice; full pytest in both precheck and the CI pytest step) and the
  slowest gates; optimize the fast per-change loop while keeping CI fail-closed.
- Clarify what is fatal vs advisory, and the area-scoping rules.

## In scope
- Audit scripts/dev/precheck.py (_GATES tiers/areas), the pre-commit/pre-push hooks, .github/workflows/structure.yml,
  config/test-matrix.json, config/validation-profiles.json.
- Produce the change->gate matrix (extend the CI/CD SSOT Part A/B) + a "why" per gate + dedup/timing findings.
- Propose (and, where safe, implement) optimizations: remove duplicate runs, right-size tiers, tighten area-scoping.

## Out of scope
- Changing gate semantics; the deferred orchestrator CI/CD view (BI-PF-1245).

## Acceptance
- Documented change->gate/test matrix with owners + tier + fatal/advisory, and a list of concrete optimizations.
- Measured fast-tier and CI times before/after; CI stays fail-closed.

## Related
docs/CI-CD-AND-GATES-SSOT.md (SSOT); BI-PF-0382/0384 (tiers/scoped tests).
